definitions.gloss: to flee, to run away, to escape
definitions.explanation: To start running away from danger, a threatening situation, or something unpleasant. Emphasizes the sudden start of the escape action.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}は{警察|けいさつ}から{逃|に}げ{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The criminal fled from the police.

examples.japanese: {怖|こわ}くなって{逃|に}げ{出|だ}したくなった。
examples.english: I got scared and wanted to run away.

examples.japanese: {火事|かじ}になり、{全員|ぜんいん}が{建物|たてもの}から{逃|に}げ{出|だ}した。
examples.english: A fire broke out, and everyone fled from the building.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Compound verb: {逃|に}げる + {出|だ}す. Pattern: Xから{逃|に}げ{出|だ}す (flee from X).

ASPECT: ている indicates completed action. {逃|に}げ{出|だ}している = 'has fled.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{現実|げんじつ}から{逃|に}げ{出|だ}す (run away from reality)
・{責任|せきにん}から{逃|に}げ{出|だ}す (flee from responsibility)
・{一目散|いちもくさん}に{逃|に}げ{出|だ}す (flee at full speed)

NUANCE: The {出|だ}す component emphasizes the start of the action - the moment of beginning to flee.
